what: Several arch windows with semicircle tops open from .8x scale and transparent over 1s after 1.6s (each window staggered .15s, expo-out), and the photo strip inside settles down from 1.2x. Once all are open, every 6s per window (staggered .2s per window) the old photo fades out over 1s and the new photo fades in over 1s starting .2s later, and the visible photo slowly pushes in 1 → 1.1x over 6s — for a hero and pinned photo that shows one scene split across three windows

options.delay: Delay before opening (seconds), default 1.6 — time before the logo and curtain rise
options.dur · each: Open length and cell order (seconds), default 1 · .15
options.intro: open (default, cell .8→1 · transparent→1) · clip (photo row is revealed from below with clip-path, original at 1024px and below — length set by dur 2) · none (runs right away)
options.fade · overlap: Off/on length and overlap (seconds), default 1 · .8 (the new photo turns on .2s later)
options.zoom · zoom-dur: Zoom scale and duration of the lit photo, default 1.1 · 6
options.--fx-arch: Arch radius (set via style), default 999px (semicircle of the cell width)
options.[data-fx-part=frame] · [data-fx-part=lis: Arch cell · photo strip inside the cell · single photo
options.fx:open: Fired on the element when opening ends and the handoff begins

from.where: index.html .ff-visual (hero three arches) · all pages .ff-sticky (left pinned single arch) — original VisualSlide: frame scale .8·opacity 0 → 1, list scale 1.2 → 1, 1s cubic-bezier(.19,1,.22,1) .15 stagger delay 1.6 / each slot setTimeout 6000+200n then setInterval 6s, old slide opacity 0 1s, new slide '-=0.8' On opacity 1 1s + scale 1.1 6s none
